Description: Core connector for handling HTTP requests and responses
Transfers and manages files using the Secure File Transfer Protocol.
Version Notes: Connector 1.x uses com.jcraft; Connector 2.x uses org.apache.sshd

Special Instructions: Enable the FTP package as well because FTPS uses the FTP connector.

Description: Connects to relational databases via JDBC
Reads and writes files on the local filesystem
Connects Mule applications to IBM MQ messaging queues.
Special Instructions: Set com.ibm.msg.client.commonservices.trace.level=8, trace.outputName=/tmp/mule_mqjms_%PID%.log, and trace.status=ON for IBM MQ JMS driver tracing.

Driver Package Name(s): httpclient.wire.header, httpclient.wire.content, httpclient.wire, org.apache.commons.httpclient, org.apache.http, com.netsuite.webservices, com.mulesoft.connector.netsuite

Version Notes: Version-specific HL7 EDI parser scopes may also be required.

Description: Connects Mule applications to Apache Cassandra databases.
Spring Web Client in Mule applications.
Core Message Receiver in Mule applications.
Publishes and consumes messages through MQTT brokers.
Provides bidirectional real-time communication using WebSockets.
